What arrives from the factory

A house kit is the walls, windows, doors, floor and roof frame. Everything hatched is not in the kit price. We can do it separately.

  1. 1Final roofing
  2. 2Rafters and battens
  3. 3Wall, 44 mm timber
  4. 4Window, double glazed
  5. 520 mm floor and joists
  6. 6Foundation

In the kit

  • WallsPlaned kiln-dried pine and spruce timber, tongue-and-groove joints, wind lock
  • Windows and doorsTimber, single-chamber double glazing. Number and position per model design
  • Floor20 mm floor boards and joists
  • Roof frameRafters and roof battens
  • FixingsFull fixing kit for assembly

Separate, we can do it

  • Final roof covering
  • Foundation
  • Delivery and unloading
  • Assembly
  • Paint and timber protection
  • Wiring, plumbing, insulation, furniture

Roof: frame yes, covering no

Rafters and battens are in the kit. Metal sheet, metal tile or bitumen shingles are bought separately. Fitting the covering is part of our assembly.

44 or 34 mm

44 mm timber is the main wall for houses and saunas. 34 mm is for small structures: sheds, gazebos, outdoor toilets. Wall thickness is not insulation.

    Questions

    What is in the house kit?

    Planed kiln-dried timber walls, timber windows and doors with single-chamber glazing, 20 mm floor boards with joists, rafters, roof battens and fixings.

    Is the roof included?

    The roof frame is: rafters and battens. The final covering (metal sheet, metal tile, shingles) is not. Fitting it is part of our assembly; the material is quoted separately.

    How much is assembly?

    15–20% of the kit price, on a ready foundation, including fitting the final roofing. Delivery is not included.

    How long does it take?

    A model in stock ships once paid and delivery is agreed. Made to order: 1,5–2 months after the deposit, plus delivery and assembly.

    Can I change the size?

    No. Sizes and structure of standard models are set by the factory. We will find the closest model or suggest a custom frame house.

    What foundation do I need?

    It depends on the soil, slope and model: concrete blocks, piles or another base. From site photos we can tell whether a visit is needed.

    Can I assemble it myself?

    Yes, the kit goes together following the manufacturer's scheme. We will explain the foundation and unloading requirements.

    Do I need a permit?

    It depends on the use and the plot. The municipality confirms the rules by cadastral code; we can help prepare the questions.

    How long will it last?

    With proper use, protection and timely treatment a timber structure can last for decades. The manufacturer does not state a specific service life.
